data.gender_notes: Raahima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman whose name means 'the merciful one'. Derived from the Arabic word 'rahim', meaning 'mercy'. The name Raahima carries the meaning “The Merciful One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raahima usually hope their child will grow to embody the merciful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies kindness, compassion, and mercy towards others.
data.etymology: Raahima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Merciful One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raahima total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: In many Islamic communities, where names often carry deep meanings and reflect the values and moral virtues that are important in the Islamic tradition, the name 'Raahima' would be seen as a reminder of the importance of showing compassion, empathy, and being kind and merciful towards others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Raahima' represents the ultimate character and attributes of God Almighty. God is often referred to as the 'Ar-Raheem', the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate, and the most Gracious (Quran 11:90). Therefore, the name 'Raahima' serves as a constant reminder of the divine mercy and love of God towards all creation. Through adhering to and embodying the traits of mercy, compassion, and kindness, one can draw closer to God, and seek His infinite mercy and forgiveness in this life and in the next.
